title: Print Prepress, CMYK & Bound-Book Preview
objective: Add print-specific output profiles: trim/bleed/safe marks, page numbering/spreads, color-space/CMYK preview or conversion through approved renderers, printer-facing checks and a local bound-book/spread preview. This does not authorize printing purchases or commercial publication.
acceptance: Print profiles expose explicit trim, bleed and safe-area metadata without rewriting canonical page/panel/layer identity.
Page numbering and spread ordering derive deterministically from governed page sequence and remain presentation/export metadata.
CMYK/color-space preview or conversion uses only approved renderer/color-management capability references and does not create a duplicate renderer or color engine.
Printer-facing checks are deterministic local preflight results and cannot silently repair source content or rights state.
Bound-book/spread preview is local presentation-only state and cannot become canonical layout or publication truth.
Printing purchases, commercial publication, vendor submission and network upload remain unauthorized.
SAA-26 page/webtoon identity and all earlier ARI/PAPT/PCA/source-owner boundaries remain sealed.
SAA-28 and later multimedia/interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-27 owns print-prepress profile, preview and validation semantics only; canonical comic identity and approved renderer/color-management authority remain with existing owners.
No duplicate renderer, color engine, asset/material, page/panel/layer, Character, Scene, Dialogue or narrative ledger may be created.
Preview/conversion cannot silently mutate source-domain truth or rights state.
No printing purchase, commercial publication, vendor submission or network side effect is authorized.
Provider-off/local preview remains valid where approved local renderer/color-management capabilities exist.
SAA-28 remains blocked until verified SAA-27 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-27.
